subject: Inbound hublet RSVP fallback + field swag ops
messages:
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Sarah Liu <sarah.liu@cloudbridge.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 9 May 2028 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: Inbound hublet RSVP fallback + field swag ops

Hi Sarah + CloudBridge team,

Thanks again for co-hosting the Dev Day hublets next month — excited to get the regional RSVP flows locked down so we can hit target attendance. Attaching an initial seedlist and the tracking matrix for review (seedlist_hublets.csv, tracking_matrix_v2.xlsx).

High-level plan (asks / actions in bold):
- Target cohorts: platform architects, infra engineers, current customers (champions). We recommend per-hublet pools of ~150 seeded emails.
- RSVP routing: primary RSVP goes to redwood.com/event/rsvp with UTM params per hub (see tracking_matrix_v2.xlsx).
- Fallbacks: if primary RSVP page errors, route to a lightweight CloudBridge-hosted form (fallback link) to preserve conversions. We need your hosting URL and a recommended UTM prefix.
- Reminders cadence: initial invite, 3-day reminder, 24-hour reminder, and a final day-of push for no-shows. Each reminder should have a slightly different subject line and a single CTA.
- Field swag: small hublet kits (stickers, notepad, 1x hoodies for VIPs). We need a consolidated shipping template from you with ship windows (see swag-address-template.csv placeholder).

Can you confirm: 1) CloudBridge fallback form URL and preferred UTM prefix, 2) whether you can accept international shipping addresses for Australia/EU hublets, and 3) preferred co-branding logo for the registration confirmation page?

If that looks good, I’ll update the seedlist to include country codes and wire up the fallback links in the tracking matrix.

Thanks —
Ben
Ben Carter | Senior GTM, Field Events | Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0192

Attachments: seedlist_hublets.csv, tracking_matrix_v2.xlsx

From: Sarah Liu <sarah.liu@cloudbridge.ai>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Cc: Tom Chen <tom.chen@cloudbridge.ai>, partners@cloudbridge.ai
Date: Wed, 10 May 2028 11:42:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Inbound hublet RSVP fallback + field swag ops

Thanks Ben — appreciate the detail. A few quick clarifications before we lock everything: 

1) "Hublet" definition — are these 30–50 person satellite watch parties or 100+ local meetups? That will change lead seed priorities and swag counts.
2) Fallback form — we can host a simple Google Form at https://forms.cloudbridge.ai/devday-fallback, but we prefer UTM source=cloudbridge-fallback. Is that acceptable?
3) GDPR/shipping — we can ship to EU addresses but need a PII handling note on the confirmation page. We also need an example of the CSV column headers you expect for the shipping template.
4) Co-branding — we can share a high-res logo pack; do you need a transparent PNG and an SVG?

Would also love to confirm timeline: when do you need the final seeded list (with country columns) from us to meet a 2-week ship lead time?

Subject: Fwd: Inbound hublet RSVP fallback + field swag ops — actions

Folks,

Looping you all for ops — please see Sarah's questions below. Action items: 

- Marissa: please confirm recommended hublet size per region (NA / EU / APAC) and adjust seed counts. I think NA hubs = 100–150, EU hubs = 60–100, APAC hubs = 40–80 depending on city.
- Lauren: confirm UTM suffixes and set CloudBridge fallback source to "cloudbridge-fallback" in the tracking matrix. Update tracking_matrix_v2.xlsx accordingly.
- Priyom: own shipping ingestion — I'll attach a shipping template and example headers (swag-address-template.csv). We need the final seedlist from CloudBridge by 2028-05-19 to meet a 2-week ship window.
- Vivek: confirm co-branding asset specs (PNG + SVG) — Sarah asked for formats.

I've attached the shipping template and a quick checklist for GDPR notes. Will produce an updated attendee-seedlist-v3.csv once country codes are added.

Ben

Attachments: swag-address-template.csv

Date: Fri, 12 May 2028 16:28:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Inbound hublet RSVP fallback + field swag ops — final confirmation

Hi team — thanks for the quick turnaround. Confirming final scope from Redwood: 

- Hublet sizing: NA hubs = 125 seeded emails per hub (we'll CPT to 100–150 range), EU hubs = 75, APAC hubs = 50. We will reserve 10 VIP hoodie allocations per NA hub for on-site champions.
- Fallback: OK to use cloudbridge-fallback UTM. Ben / Lauren — please update tracking_matrix_v2.xlsx to set the fallback source as "cloudbridge-fallback" and include a dedicated column for fallback performance.
- Shipping: Priyom — use swag-address-template.csv (attached) as the ingestion format. Sarah, please return final CSV with headers: email, full_name, street_address, city, state_province, postal_code, country_code, phone, special_instructions. Deadline for CSV: 2028-05-19 23:59 PDT to meet a ship window beginning 2028-06-05.
- Assets: Vivek — Sarah confirmed PNG + SVG; ask them for high-res 300dpi for print.

Attachments: swag-budget.xlsx, attendee-seedlist-v3.csv

Sarah — once we get the final CSV and logo pack we’ll schedule the first reminder cadence and publish the fallback link in the tracking matrix. Looking forward to a smooth co-host.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Head of Field Marketing | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com | +1 650-555-0124
